questionnaires.title: Questionnaires
questionnaires.intro: Each questionnaire reuses questions and rules from the library. The public only sees the published version; your changes stay in draft until the next publication. The order below is the order on the home page.
questionnaires.key_hint: Used in the address (/q/<key>). Letters, digits and "_". Cannot be changed afterwards.
questionnaires.name: Title
questionnaires.featured_label: Feature this questionnaire on the home page (main button)

builder.published_ok: Published: the public now sees this version.
builder.unpublished_ok: The questionnaire is no longer visible to the public.
builder.saved_draft: Saved in the draft. Publish to put it online.
builder.content_intro: Sections follow one another in order. An optional section is offered after the others. Each question comes from the bank: its wording is shared, while the settings below belong to this questionnaire.
builder.optional_label: Optional section (offered after the others, like "additional questions")
builder.pick_question: — Choose a question from the bank —
builder.create_question: Create a question in the bank
builder.show_if_hint: Without a condition, the question is always asked. The condition may only refer to questions in this questionnaire.
builder.outcomes_intro: The result kept is the last one (in order) whose minimum score is reached. A result without a minimum score is only given when a rule imposes it.
builder.min_score_hint: Empty: result only given by a rule.
builder.next_hint: Answers already given are carried over to the next questionnaire.
builder.outcome_contacts_hint: Shown first, before those added by rules.
builder.rules_intro: Each rule that applies adds its points, attention points, suggestions and contacts. The first applying rule that imposes a result overrides the score. Points and imposed result belong to this questionnaire; the condition and messages are shared.
builder.no_rules: No rules: the result will only depend on the score (0).
builder.pick_rule: — Choose a rule from the library —
builder.create_rule: Create a rule in the library
builder.add_rule_hint: Only rules whose questions are all in this questionnaire are offered.
builder.settings_hint: The title and description appear on the home page once published.
builder.delete_hint: Questions and rules stay in the library. Published versions are deleted.

questions.title: Question bank
questions.intro: A question is written once and can be placed in several questionnaires. Editing its wording changes every draft that uses it (republish to put it online).
questions.used_in: Used in: {list}. A change will appear in these questionnaires when they are next published.
questions.saved_used: Saved. Republish the questionnaires concerned to put it online.
questions.text_falc_hint: Optional: shown when the person turns on simplified texts.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: A rule describes when it applies and what it adds to the results page. It can be used in several questionnaires.
rules.used_in: Used in: {list}. Its condition must remain valid in each of these questionnaires.
rules.saved_used: Saved. Republish the questionnaires concerned to put it online.
rules.explanation: Explanation shown under "What was taken into account"
rules.explanation_hint: Optional. Only shown if the rule adds points or imposes a result.
rules.condition_hint: Every question in the bank is offered; the rule can only be added to questionnaires that contain the questions it refers to.
rules.messages_hint: The wording of attention points, suggestions and contacts is edited under "Messages and contacts".

messages.title: Messages and contacts
messages.intro: Library shared by all questionnaires. Changes appear when the questionnaires that use them are next published.
messages.flags_intro: Shown under "Points to keep in mind", in the order below, when a rule adds them.
messages.suggestions_intro: Shown under "Ways forward", in the order rules add them.
messages.contacts_intro: Offered by results and rules. Those bound by medical confidentiality come first when an attention point asks for it.
messages.highlight_confidential: When this attention point is shown, offer contacts bound by medical confidentiality first
messages.name: Name
messages.group_none: Do not show on the Resources page

pages.title: "Learn more" pages
pages.intro: The order below is the order of the "Learn more" menu.
pages.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens: the page will be at /info/{slug}.
pages.published_label: Page published (otherwise: draft hidden from the public)
pages.blocks_hint: Blocks are shown in this order under the introduction.

resources.title: Resources
resources.hint_official: Shown in the resource kit and its PDF. Openings are counted in the statistics.
resources.hint_law: Resources page, "What the law says" section.
